This marks Young’s second win in seven months after earning his first Tour victory at the 2025 Wyndham Championship.Runner-up Matt Fitzpatrick earned $2,725,000. Xander Schauffele was solo third to win $1,725,000, and Robert MacIntyre was solo fourth to win $1,225,000.Ludvig Åberg entered Sunday with the lead, but after dropping to T-5, he lost out on $3,575,000.
